validation.source_bounds_note: OSM map includes complete ways that intersect requested boxes; their nodes can extend far beyond requested bounds. These are raw node bounds, not imported road-network bounds.

route_overlay.reason: Resolve an explicit conflict between the frozen official 701 outbound shape and imported OSM turn topology; this is a modelling assumption pending operator/street validation.

connections.evidence: The official outbound 701 shape and frozen OSM route relation 10107392 both continue from way 966302094 to 477791560. OSM way 477791560 has oneway:bus=no and already imports a bus-capable contraflow edge.
connections.limits: Bus-only connector in both baseline and proposal. Ordinary traffic retains the imported right-turn restriction. This does not establish legal current street permissions.
